activities.title: Scavenger hunt on your screen
activities.intro: Open a blank document in your own word processor. Find each part, tick the step, then answer the questions.

items: Set the zoom to 120%, then back to 100%.
Find the word count of your blank page.
Open the File tab or menu and find Save As and Export (Docs: Download). Press Esc to go back.

blocks.prompt: What word count does your blank page show?
In Word, where did you find the word count?
You set the zoom to 120%. What happens when you print?
options: Nothing changes. Zoom is for the screen only.
The page prints on two sheets

help: Zoom: slider at the bottom right (Docs: zoom box on the toolbar).
Word count: status bar (Docs: Ctrl + Shift + C).

activities.title: Start the letter and save it the right way
activities.intro: Paste the raw text of our invitation letter into a new document and save it with a proper name. Keep this file: you will improve it in 2.2 and 2.3.

items: Open a new blank document (Ctrl + N).
Copy the raw text from the chat and paste it (Ctrl + V).
Save As (F12 in Word) into your training folder from Topic 1.2.
Name it Letter - Digital Skills Workshop Invitation - 2026-11-03
Keep the type Word Document (.docx). Writer: .odt or .docx. Docs: click the title at the top left and rename.
Export a PDF copy into the same folder.

blocks.prompt: Type the exact file name you used (without .docx).
This letter had never been saved. Which command did you use to give it a name and a folder?
Which files of the letter should be in your training folder now? Pick all that apply.
Optional: a screenshot of your training folder showing both files

activities.title: Quick check: Save or Save As?

blocks.prompt: You want to update October's report for November, but keep October's file unchanged. What do you do first?
options: Save As with a new name, then edit
Export it as PDF, then edit the PDF
Zoom to 150% so the changes stand out
